craft_notes: Color: communal joy (rasa communal per argmap). Vocative kept; festival kept public. REJECTED OPTIONS (with killers): (a) modernizing festival -> killed: utsava is ancient-public. (b) they-bring->announce kept: bring brings. Read aloud: THEY-hon-or THE-love-FES-ti-val WITH be-LOV-eds — … CLOUD-arriv-al, DEAR-friend, THEY-bring. Abhinavagupta frame: rasa shifting śṛṅgāra → vīra/adbhuta — lover's voice yielding to poet's; sthāyibhāva (love) resolving into camatkāra (wonder at craft); seal names its own vessel.

lines: They honor the love-festival with beloveds —
l4.sanskrit_cite: ratyutsavaṃ priyatamaiḥ saha mānayanti meghāgamaṃ priyasakhi śvasamānayanti

c1_essence: The rasa shifts from śṛṅgāra to vira/adbhuta: love and landscape are framed by the poet's skill, not by love alone. Clouds thundering make travelers long; sorrow grows, endless. Lovers honor the love-festival; cloud-arrival, dear friend, they bring. Then the tribute: may I be conquered by which poet, by yamakas; to him I pour water in ghaṭakarpara. The sthāyibhāva (love) resolves into the poet's own delight (camatkāra) at his craft. The potsherd is both vessel and namesake — the potsherd names itself at its close.
reads_against.c1_rasa: vira/adbhuta (heroic skill + wonder at craft), resolving from śṛṅgāra
